tasks.label: Publish revision
tasks.detail: Ship the build as a new revision. Press Enter to publish under the default name, or type a name (a new name starts a new named head).

tasks.label: Start ComfyUI
tasks.detail: Start ComfyUI from C:\ComfyUI (its own venv) on http://127.0.0.1:8188 with the CORS header the hive's /comfy word needs.

inputs.description: Revision name — leave empty for the default name (essentials)
